name: Cyberion ThreatShield - Detection Coverage
description: Coverage of 22 Sigma + 4 correlation rules validated on EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES. Green=covered, yellow=partial, red=not covered.

techniques.comment: Covered. Rules: DET-001, DET-002. Security 1102 and System 104. Benign lab-prep clears seen in 24 samples (see tuning).
Covered. Rules: DET-003, DET-019, COR-003. Sysmon EID10 access rights, PowerShell 4104, and LSASS+injection correlation.
Covered. Rules: DET-013. Non-machine account with replication GUIDs and Control Access.
Covered. Rules: DET-004, COR-004. Includes renamed regsvr32 via /i:http (added after validation miss).
Covered. Rules: DET-005. Script/URL handler abuse of rundll32; also catches the mshtml RunHTMLApplication variant.
Covered. Rules: DET-009, DET-010, DET-020, COR-001. Registry hijack plus elevated child, chained by COR-001.
Covered. Rules: DET-011, COR-002. Remote-thread creation into commonly injected processes; burst correlation.
Covered. Rules: DET-015. Service with interpreter binary path (7045).
Covered. Rules: DET-016. 4698 outside Microsoft task path; updater noise expected.
Covered. Rules: DET-018. Loopback-sourced RDP logon (type 10).
Covered. Rules: DET-007. IFEO Debugger value write.
Covered. Rules: DET-021. Rule created from Hunt 01 findings.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-006, COR-004. bitsadmin CLI only. COM/PowerShell BITS job creation (Bits-Client log) not covered.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-007. IFEO debugger path only; the osk.exe-spawns-shell outcome in the sample is not detected.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-008. Path heuristic; Run keys pointing at trusted-looking paths are missed.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-010. Only the EnableLUA value is covered; other tamper keys are not.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-012. Sysmon-based. Security 4688 sample LM_WMI_4624_4688_TargetHost has no parent field so was missed.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-014. svcctl pipe access only; C$/ADMIN$ file copy (5145) not covered.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-014. Detected at SCM RPC stage, not at service execution.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-017. seclogo logon type 9 only; NTLM type-3 pass-the-hash not covered.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-018. Only tunnelled RDP; ordinary lateral RDP not covered.
Partially Covered. Rules: DET-022, COR-004. LOLBin network egress only; browser/curl/PowerShell downloads not covered.
Not Covered. Rules: none. Direct mshta.exe execution has no rule (only the rundll32/mshtml variant is covered).
Not Covered. Rules: none. Hidden ($-suffixed) account registry change.
Not Covered. Rules: none. DCShadow rogue DC registration (4742).
Not Covered. Rules: none. Token duplication / impersonation.
Not Covered. Rules: none. PetiPotam forced authentication via EFSRPC.
Not Covered. Rules: none. Zerologon exploitation (NetLogon 5805).
Not Covered. Rules: none. BloodHound/SharpHound domain account enumeration.
Not Covered. Rules: none. WMI event subscription persistence (Sysmon 19/20/21).
Not Covered. Rules: none. Timestomp (Sysmon EID 2) - no rule.
Not Covered. Rules: none. Network share enumeration.
